title: Liquid
tagline: Create a social on-chain profile and earn GHO rewards from your audience
description:
Everything you are. In one, simple link in bio. Liquid helps you share everything you create, curate, and sell on social platforms. The fast, friendly, and powerful link-in bio tool. It connects your on-chain reputation and social visibility across multiple networks. We built a platform that simplifies the creator’s content, monetization, and growth. You can get GHO tips from your audience into your wallet! There are lots of actual use cases for liquid and it disrupts the e-commerce market, creator economy, and influencers strategy.

The platform's most distinctive aspect is its ability to ensure transparency and composability with the most efficient scaling solutions. The smart contract handles these operations, and simplifies the creator profile.
how_its_made: This project uses @connectkit SDK and Wagmi behind the scenes to connect with testnet network. We used Solidity to develop a smart contract that initializes a user’s profile and the utility of rewards. The smart contract is deployed on the @Sepolia. We created this semantic frontend using NextJS, Tailwind CSS, and React. We've designed Liquid in such a way that it helps any user to create their own profile easily. It’s simple and basic. This project uses @wagmi behind the scenes so any users can reward their creators in GHO token which can be received directly in the creator’s wallet.
